description: Configure the existing product 'Wireless Bluetooth Headphones' as an exclusive limited-release item. In the WooCommerce admin panel: 1. Change the Catalog Visibility to 'Search results only' (so it doesn't appear in the main shop loop). 2. Enable the 'Sold individually' inventory option to limit purchases to 1 item per order. 3. Update the Product Short Description by appending the text '*** LIMIT 1 PER CUSTOMER ***' to the end. Save the product changes.
